args.body: Hi Dora — I visited your website and it gives a clear, simple personal introduction. I like that it feels straightforward and personal. One suggestion: you could add a bit more detail about your interests, projects, or what you want visitors to learn about you, so the site feels even more engaging.

Hi Eve — I checked out your blog and liked the personal touch, especially seeing that hiking is your favorite hobby. That detail makes the blog feel warm and approachable. If you want to make it even stronger, you could highlight your hiking stories or favorite trails more prominently so visitors immediately get a sense of your personality and content.
